assessments.reasoning: The publisher’s unannotated Ada 2022 Reference Manual identifies §9.5.3 as Entry Calls and marks paragraphs 7/3, 8, 12, and 21 as active in the edition. The full freshly downloaded HTTPS response matches the registered source SHA-256. Paragraph 12 explicitly gives the closed-entry queue insertion, while paragraphs 1 and 8 identify the ordinary simple-call context and the check. The quote ends after the insertion action. The successor proposition addresses an ordinary returned closed result at the time of checking. The active unannotated Ada 2022 edition applies. The claim’s scope is queue insertion and its condition presupposes normal progress to paragraph 12. Paragraph 7/3 covers exceptions propagated by a protected barrier evaluation. Paragraph 21 covers completed and abnormal tasks before acceptance or rendezvous completion. The limitations report both and avoid a universal queue-residence claim.

limitations: A protected entry barrier that propagates an exception triggers paragraph 7/3: Program_Error propagates to all current callers of the protected object's entries.
Paragraph 21 raises Tasking_Error at the caller if the called task has completed or if it completes or becomes abnormal before acceptance or completion of the rendezvous.
The provision selected here concerns insertion into the queue. Later completion is governed by the applicable selection, cancellation, and exceptional paths.
